description: Get your home's GPS coordinates to automate your shades according to the sun's course.
security_text: Privacy & security: This page runs entirely in your browser. No data is stored or sent to any third-party server.
err_gps_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
err_no_results: No results. Try adding the country, or a different spelling.
err_search_failed: Search failed (this step needs an internet connection).
installer_description: Flash your ESP32 straight from this browser, over a USB cable.
installer_compat_warning: Browser installation requires Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer (Web Serial), with this page loaded over HTTPS.
installer_box_section_title: 📦 Do you own an ESPSomfy-RTS box?
installer_box_section_hint: Your box's image is already prepared: a single button is enough.
installer_step1_hint: The model is usually printed on the board or in its documentation.
installer_step2_hint: You'll be able to select {lang} right from the first boot: the box will automatically download the matching translation pack as soon as it has internet access.
installer_step3_no_board: First choose a board in step 1.
installer_erase_notice: ⚠️ A full flash erase is performed automatically before installation. The USB port is chosen in your browser's native picker when you click "Install".
installer_security_text: Privacy & security: Flashing happens entirely in your browser, talking directly to your USB device. The firmware is downloaded from the project's GitHub releases; no data is sent to any other third party.
